caption: The drawing features two main elements on a beige background. At the top center, there is a detailed, roughly oval area filled with brown shading and stippling, containing text that reads "2 O.S. CADWELL, & CO. HARTFORD" in uppercase, along with a simple coat of arms or shield with flourishes underneath the text. Below this, towards the center of the page, is a black line drawing of a cylindrical jar with a slight lip at the top and faint handles suggested on the sides. The jar is depicted upright and bears a smaller, simplified version of the same text and coat of arms seen above. The artist’s signature, "THOMAS AULL," appears in the bottom left corner in small, neat script.
title: Churn
